description.value: Coast Hillcrest Hotel is a full-service Coast Hotels chain property in Revelstoke, BC, positioned at the base of the Selkirk and Monashee Mountains within easy reach of Revelstoke Mountain Resort. The hotel features on-site dining at the Begbie Room and Mountain View Terrace, a lounge with fireplace, an indoor and outdoor hot tub, steam room, dry sauna, fitness centre, and an on-site spa. It offers a free seasonal shuttle to the ski hill and is pet-friendly, making it a comfortable recovery base after long days in the mountains.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity information for Coast Hillcrest Hotel. Contact details (address 2100 Oak Drive, phone 250.837.3322, email info@hillcresthotel.com) on the website exactly match the OSM record. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying areas, tools, pump, or e-bike charging appears anywhere in the fetched content; Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed as free throughout the hotel, and on-site dining (Begbie Room, Mountain View Terrace, Guides Lounge) confirms evening food availability.
concerns: OSM name 'Coast Hillcrest' omits 'Hotel' from the full brand name 'Coast Hillcrest Hotel' as shown on the website — minor truncation, not a substantive discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel with an active website and confirmed contact details; a clear choice for touring cyclists seeking full-service accommodation in Revelstoke.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site dining at Begbie Room and Mountain View Terrace; evening drinks at Guides Lounge
